sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:58

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:58:1
items.html: Male and female within him, which are MA and BON, mixed together completely, etc.; “There is no left in this hidden Atika, it is all right”: For he took the GAR of the Keter of Nekudim, where the GAR of Bina is in completeness, as they were in Nekudim from their own emanation, which is the very light of the Ozen [ear], and was not flawed by the breaking at all. And therefore there is no discernment of left in Atika, meaning that there is no discernment of Nukva there that would be lacking Hassadim, as above. But rather “it is all right.” For even the Nukva of Atik is the discernment of right, meaning that she is in the completion of the Hassadim.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:58:2
items.html: Front and back, etc.; and in this there is a wondrous and very great union: However, these discernments of posterior are not revealed in him, but rather the front of MA is on one side, and the front of BON is on the second side, and the two discernments of their posterior are between them. And one should not raise the difficulty, from the above, that the discernment of back does not apply in GAR. For in Atik it is different, since the root bottom Hey is hidden within him. As above (page 618, item 24; and see Inner Light there). And understand, for there is no room to elaborate.
